## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation / wiki / metadata
- [ ] Bug fix (no change to published numerical results)
- [ ] Scientific change (model, equation, constant, or a published number)
- [ ] New feature / public API addition
- [ ] Maintenance / CI / tooling

## Reproducibility checklist

- [ ] `pytest` passes (259 passed, 3 xfailed)
- [ ] Relevant verification scripts pass (`verify_suite.py`, `verify_paper3.py`, `companion/verify_ai1.py`)
- [ ] No published or oracle expected values were edited to make tests pass
- [ ] New public functions validate their inputs and are tested

## Scientific changes only

- [ ] Derivation or source for the change is provided
- [ ] Affected result reproduced before/after
- [ ] Impact on published values / DOIs noted (or "none")

## Backward compatibility

- [ ] Public API (`orbital_thermal`) names/signatures/defaults unchanged, or the change is documented in `CHANGELOG.md`

## AI assistance

- [ ] Any AI-assisted authorship is disclosed and I have verified correctness myself
